- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail.
- Comfortable communicating directly with clients and external professionals.
- Able to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines.

- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.

- Opportunity to work closely with experienced Family Law solicitors.
- Greater involvement in legal matters and case progression.

title: Private Client Legal Secretary
description:
Are you an experienced Private Client Legal Secretary looking to join a quality-driven law firm where you will feel valued, supported and part of a close-knit team?

I am working with a highly regarded law firm based in Sevenoaks who are looking to recruit an experienced Legal Secretary to join their busy and established Private Client department.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a firm that combines high-quality legal work with a genuinely friendly, supportive and welcoming working environment. With a family-feel culture, this is a firm where people work collaboratively, support one another and take pride in what they do.

The Role You will provide essential secretarial and administrative support to the Private Client team, assisting with a varied and interesting caseload.

Your duties will include:
- Providing comprehensive secretarial support to fee earners within the Private Client department.
- Preparing, formatting and amending legal documents and correspondence.
- Assisting with matters relating to Wills, Probate, Estate Administration, Tax and Lasting Powers of Attorney.
- Managing diaries, arranging appointments and handling client communications.
- Opening and maintaining client files and ensuring records are kept up to date.
- Liaising professionally and sensitively with clients, beneficiaries and other professionals.
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the department.

About You To be considered, you will ideally have:
- Previous experience working as a Legal Secretary within a Private Client department.
- A good understanding of Private Client matters, including Wills, Probate, Tax and Lasting Powers of Attorney.
- Excellent typing, spelling and document preparation skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- A professional, friendly and approachable manner.
- A proactive attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a supportive team.
- A genuine commitment to providing an excellent level of client care.

Why Join? This is an opportunity to join a well-established firm offering:
- High-quality and interesting legal work.
- A friendly, welcoming and supportive team environment.
- A genuine family-feel culture where colleagues look out for one another.
- A full-time, Monday to Friday working pattern, 9am-5pm.
- The opportunity to become a valued member of an established and busy department.

If you would be interested in finding out more about this role or hear about any other opportunities, please reach out to Rhian Thompson at QED Legal () or alternatively click on the "APPLY" button below
